title: Who will win the men's singles title at the 2026 Mubadala DC Open?
background: The Mubadala DC Open is a professional tennis tournament in Washington, D.C. Its men's singles competition is part of the ATP Tour.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The official ATP results for the 2026 Mubadala DC Open.
